name: Clotizolam
summary: Clotizolam (Ro11-1465) is a thienotriazolodiazepine derivative first invented in the 1970s, which in more recent years has been sold as a designer drug. As with other related thienotriazolodiazepines, it produces sedative, anxiolytic, anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant effects, and also acts as an inhibitor of platelet-activating factor (PAF).

pharmacology.text: As with other related thienotriazolodiazepines, it produces sedative, anxiolytic, anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant effects, and also acts as an inhibitor of platelet-activating factor (PAF).

uses.text: Clotizolam (Ro11-1465) is a thienotriazolodiazepine derivative first invented in the 1970s, which in more recent years has been sold as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the benzodiazepines, can cause drowsiness, poor coordination and memory problems, lead to dependence with dangerous withdrawal including seizures, and in overdose can slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的苯二氮平類藥物可能造成嗜睡、協調變差與記憶問題，可能導致依賴，戒斷時可能出現包括癲癇發作在內的危險症狀，過量時可能抑制呼吸。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的苯二氮平类药物可能造成嗜睡、协调制差与记忆问题，可能导致依赖，戒断时可能出现包括癫痫发作在内的危险症状，过量时可能抑制呼吸。

fact.en: The Ro in its code name, Ro11-1465, marks it as a compound from the Swiss company Roche. It was made in the 1970s but only reached people decades later, as a designer drug.
fact.zh: 它代號 Ro11-1465 中的 Ro 表示它是瑞士羅氏藥廠的化合物。它在 1970 年代合成，但直到數十年後才以設計師藥物的形式流入人群。
fact.zhHans: 它代号 Ro11-1465 中的 Ro 表示它是瑞士罗氏药厂的化合物。它在 1970 年代合成，但直到数十年后才以设计师药物的形式流入人群。
